_about: AES cost basis for Mission Control (the MD dashboard), and the MD PIN (md_pin). Edit here and run the push script. Costs only reach the page once the PIN has been given; the PIN itself never does. Drivers: hourly rates. Vehicles (haulage wagons, by driver initials): weekly lease, mpg. Service team: the service drivers and wagons, by initials. DB and AU do both, so they appear in both.

7.5t.note: 7.5t wagon, owned, depreciation. Move under vehicles with the driver's initials to cost it.

_notes: Hiab mpg 8.5 (Nathan, 01/10/2026). 4x4 30 is still a placeholder. Overtime, employer NI, pension, insurance, tyres and servicing are not included. Service team rates, wagons and finance from Nathan, 01/10/2026.
_fuel_note: Nathan, 01/10/2026: £1.50 this week and fluctuating; leave at 1.50 unless it heads back down towards £1.30, which makes the biggest difference.
_ssp_note: Statutory sick pay per day (weekly SSP over 5). Single sick days are costed at this instead of the wage; a full week off for anything other than annual leave drops the driver out of that week's wage bill. Update each April.
_hours_note: Everyone is a 45 hour week unless listed in driver_hours_per_week. AU is part time, Tue to Thu.

service_team._about: Service drivers from Big Change. They never appear on the planner schedule (haulage only); Mission Control shows them from Big Change job data via Ken.

_days_note: Working days a week, where not 5. AU: Tue to Thu.
